setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays four trigs with note masks 60, 64, 69 and 71 on steps 1-4 (velocities 127, 117, 107, 97), in a scale with Degree II and Rotation 1. On enables full scale mapping; Off disables it. An absent step lock uses the channel, and channel X uses the global option. An explicitly stored step X skips the channel and uses the global option directly; clearing it with K2 restores channel inheritance. In the state lists, X without a stored step lock means no exception; explicit step X is named separately. The state is listed as global / channel / step 1 / step 2. Now: On / Off / X / On. The channel Off beats the global On and step 2 has its own On lock, so the strip reads 60, 65, 69, 71.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: State: On / X / X / On. With no step held, turn the channel value down to X (unset). The global On applies again: 62, 65, 71, 60. Step 2 keeps its own On lock.
steps.title: Channel: X inherits the global On

steps.caption: State: On / X / Off / On. Hold step 1, turn E3 one detent up from X to Off and release. Play, then stop: step 1 plays its written note, 60, even though the global option is On. The strip reads 60, 65, 71, 60.
steps.title: Step: switch one step Off

steps.caption: State: Off / X / Off / On. Press K1, open the Mosaic params and turn Quantise note masks Off. The channel value is still X, so it follows the global Off. Play, then stop: steps 3 and 4 play as written and step 2 keeps its On lock, 60, 65, 69, 71.
steps.title: Global: turn full quantisation Off

title: Let the channel inherit the global setting
